body.p: Why the pike is bony (Dyooa). Dyooa lived alone. At this moment, Dyooa has no partner, Dyooa does not mention any partner. Dyooa also had a tent, he sleeps in a tent. He fell asleep, Dyooa is sleeping lying on his back. Oh, at some point he looked at the smoke hole: "Oh, at my smoke hole, at the light of the sky, some birds have sat down, birds.". Dyooa is counting them. There were seven birds. There were many. So they are flattering on the Dyooa's smoke hole. Dyooa said: "These birds are finally a prey, is it bad for me to kill them?" Dyooa had a bow. When he sleeps, the bow is usually with him. Dyooa took his bow and fired an arrow. A bird circling fell into the tent. As for the birds, there were seven birds. Dyooa shot all seven birds from the bow. They all fell into Dyooa's tent. Dyooa said: "Now I'll eat them, them, he said, I'll cook them in a cauldron." Dyooa plucked all seven birds. Dyooa boiled them all in one cauldron. After a while, his cauldron, of course, got ready. Now Dyooa began to eat. Dyooa is eating. He ate all his seven birds, there was nothing left. He ate them all. He ate all these seven birds with blood. These were big birds, no doubt. Having eaten seven birds, Dyooa sings on his own: "I have eaten seven birds, I ate seven wood capercaillies.". After a while Dyooa fell asleep. Having ate, he fell asleep strongly. Dyooa after a while woke up. "Oh, he said, now I want to urinate after eating.". Dyooa intentionally pissed himself. Dyooa pissed onto his bed while sleeping. After he pissed, a river overflowed at the door of his tent, a river overflowed at the door. Dyooa said: "It seems to be a good river, it looks like it will become a big good river.". After a while Dyooa said: "Oh, I want to defecate." Dyooa wanted to defecate. How he began to defecate, he began to defecate in his tent - this cannot be expressed in words. Dyooa looked at his excrement and said: "Oh, my excrement, I laid it in seven places, I made seven hills." Dyooa says: "I ate seven birds, I laid seven hills." Even now no one knows the name of his bird. He said: "Seven capercaillies, and what kind of bird is this?" The Enets have names for all birds, we know all the birds, but what is this one called in Russian? After a while, Dyooa said: "It's probably bad to live like this.". Dyooa said: "Here is my river. What's wrong with my river? A thirsty person would not find water anywhere, but my river's water is drinkable, the water is good." According to his words, Dyooa's urine is drinkable, according to his words. Dea says: "It would be nice for me to make a boat, it would be nice for me to go somewhere along my river." Dyooa probably had an axe, of course he had an axe. Whether it was the bark of a tree or a rotten one, he made himself a boat, made himself an oar. Dyooa went along his river in his boat made of tree bark. Dyooa's river has a strong stream, Dyooa's river. Dyooa went somewhere. The river carries him, of course, Dyooa rows. Dyooa sings loudly: "Hey, hey!" Dyooa said: "What the hell is that talking in the wood?" Really, someone seems to be talking. The echo responds in the forest. "What the hell is imitating me?" Dyooa said. He will swing the oars again:"Hey, hey!" It is heard again in the forest. Dyooa goes on a boat. Dyooa looks: "There is a large lake ahead of me, a lake has appeared.". Dyooa thinks: "I don't know if the water of my river has become such a big lake, but it probably is.". Dyooa went out onto a large lake. Oh, there are tents seen on the other side. "I'll rush over the lake, I'll rush to the tents, of course, I have to go across the lake, I have a boat, after all" - Dyooa says so. Dyooa wanted to defecate again. "Again after I had eaten seven birds, after I made seven hills, I wanted to defecate again. Where can I defecate?" There was a huge stone on the shore of the lake, after all, there are huge stones. Dyooa pushed the boat near the stone, jumped onto the stone. He started to defecate. While Dyooa was defecating, a large pike saw him. Oh, oh, the pike, while Dyooa was defecating, grabbed him by his balls. Dyooa shot at this pike, he had a bow. So Dyooa shot, fired all his arrows at the pike. Suddenly, the pike splashed and quickly disappeared. "Damn it, it tore all my things, injured, and I didn't kill it. Well. Now I'll go to the people," - thought Dyooa. Dyooa rushed to the other side. His groin torn by the pike is covered with blood. "What should I do with it, what should I do?" Dyooa has a sokuy. Dyooa cut a lap of his sokuy, covered and bandaged his things. Well, he came to people. People say like this: "Dyooa, why is your groin bandaged?" "I froze it, - he said, - what was the weather like yesterday?". People doubted. "This one, - they thought, - didn't get frostbite, apparently the pike met you, the pike bit you, apparently.". When people catch and eat a pike, the arrows fired by Dyooa are all in the pike. Now you know yourself that when you start eating a pike, it has many bones.[ShA:] The form ÉkuÄ is unclear. These are arrows fired by Dyooa. Dyooa is so.
